acceptance_type: DOCUMENTED ANALYST WAIVER for qualitative use - not a gate pass
gate_status: residual_interpretation NOT MET (residuals above the 1e-5 aim; the required explanation/local-error review was not completed). All conservation, target and monitor-stability gates pass.
accepted_scope: Qualitative steady, isothermal, laminar airflow pilot at an ASSUMED 1 CFM fan throughflow (the gate file scope is already a qualitative pilot, so this waiver does not narrow scope further).
source_record: claude-run/final-gates.json (all_passed=false because of the residual check)
monitor_threshold_note: final_window.py used 1 % (dp) and 2 % (peak speed) range thresholds, looser than the gate file monitor_range_target_fraction 0.005; the actual ranges (dp 3.7e-05 Pa = 0.0009 % of mean, peak speed 0.21 %) also pass 0.5 %.

exceptions.note: Oscillating (period about 90-100 iterations) with a decaying envelope: log-linear fit -0.21 decades per 100 iterations over 401-600, but z rose from 1.08e-05 (it 579) to 1.55e-05 at it 600.

exceptions.item: continuity scaled residual about 270x the 1e-5 aim and above the Fluent default 1e-3 check
exceptions.note: Fluent scales continuity by its largest value in the first five iterations (iteration 2 of the rest start); unscaled residuals were not recorded, so no inflation by scaling is demonstrated. Log-linear fit -0.21 decades per 100 iterations over 401-600; rose at the end of the window. Global outer-box mass imbalance <= 8.0e-05 of fan mass flow in all 40 native samples.

exceptions.item: mesh quality outside the preferred aim
exceptions.note: Minimum orthogonal quality 0.043 (gate floor 0.01 met, preferred 0.1 not); 53 cells below 0.1; maximum aspect ratio 230. Only the worst cell (2.17, -13.64, 30.07 mm, now inside the frozen crevice block) was located; the other 52 were not located or inspected; maximum skewness not reported.

exceptions.item: cell resolution in fan actuator, grille, side slots and ~1 mm frame gap not inspected (gate volume requirement not done)
area-weighted fan-plane pressures in the final session
exceptions.note: The original stairio-fan-*-area report definitions read +0.57 % after the session-3 surface refresh, so the reported static rise (4.243 Pa) is low; area-corrected value 4.267 Pa (claude-run/window-native-stats.json). Surface-integral fluxes are unaffected.
